```{r}
# Calculate row-wise NAs in a temporary vector
nas_per_row <- rowSums(is.na(support2))

# Set up the visualization area
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# 1. Plot for hospdead
boxplot(nas_per_row ~ support2$hospdead, 
        main = "Nulos vs. Muerte Hospitalaria",
        xlab = "hospdead (0=Vivo, 1=Muerto)", 
        ylab = "Cantidad de valores faltantes",
        col = c("skyblue", "indianred"))

# 2. Plot for death
boxplot(nas_per_row ~ support2$death, 
        main = "Nulos vs. Muerte General",
        xlab = "death (0=Vivo, 1=Muerto)", 
        ylab = "Cantidad de valores faltantes",
        col = c("skyblue", "indianred"))

# Calculate averages
cat("Average missing values by group (hospdead):\n")
print(tapply(nas_per_row, support2$hospdead, mean, na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nAverage missing values by group (death):\n")
print(tapply(nas_per_row, support2$death, mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Variables con alto missing
vars_to_check <- c(
  "pafi", "alb", "bili",
  "ph", "glucose", "bun", "urine"
)

# Loop
for (var in vars_to_check) {

  cat("\n========================\n")
  cat("Variable:", var, "\n")
  cat("========================\n")

  # Crear indicador de missing
  missing_var <- is.na(support2[[var]])

  # Tabla de proporciones por dzgroup
  result <- prop.table(
    table(support2$dzgroup, missing_var),
    margin = 1
  )

  print(round(result, 3))
}
```
```{r}
# Variables a comparar
vars_to_check <- c(
  "hospdead",
  "scoma",
  "dzgroup",
  "age",
  "dementia"
)

# Variables con muchos missing
target_vars <- c("adlp", "adls")

for (target in target_vars) {

  cat("\n========================\n")
  cat("Variable:", target, "\n")
  cat("========================\n")

  # Variable booleana de missing
  support2$missing_var <- is.na(support2[[target]])

  for (v in vars_to_check) {

    cat("\n--- Comparando con:", v, "---\n")

    # Si categórica
    if (is.factor(support2[[v]]) || is.character(support2[[v]])) {

      tbl <- prop.table(
        table(support2[[v]], support2$missing_var),
        margin = 1
      )

      print(round(tbl, 3))

    } else {

      # Convertir a numérico
      temp_var <- as.numeric(support2[[v]])

      summary_tbl <- data.frame(
        missing_var = support2$missing_var,
        temp_var = temp_var
      ) %>%
        group_by(missing_var) %>%
        summarise(
          mean = mean(temp_var, na.rm = TRUE),
          median = median(temp_var, na.rm = TRUE),
          sd = sd(temp_var, na.rm = TRUE),
          n = n(),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      print(summary_tbl)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(support2), function(v) {
  group_0 <- sum(is.na(support2[[v]][support2$hospdead == 0]))
  group_1 <- sum(is.na(support2[[v]][support2$hospdead == 1]))
  total_0 <- sum(support2$hospdead == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_1 <- sum(support2$hospdead == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  c(Nulos_Vivos = group_0, Nulos_Muertos = group_1, 
    Porc_Vivos = round((group_0/total_0)*100, 2), 
    Porc_Muertos = round((group_1/total_1)*100, 2),
    Diff = round(abs((group_1/total_1) - (group_0/total_0)) * 100, 2))
}))

rownames(results) <- names(support2)
results <- as.data.frame(results)

results <- results[rowSums(results[, 1:2]) > 0, ]
results <- results[order(results$Diff), ]

print(results)
```

```{r}
# 1. Get all native factors and manually append the labeled categorical variables
native_factors <- support2 %>%
  select(where(is.factor)) %>%
  names()

manual_categoricals <- c("hospdead","death", "diabetes", "dementia", "edu", "num.co", "pafi", "adlp", "adls")

# Combine both lists and ensure the target variable is excluded
categorical_variables <- unique(c(native_factors, manual_categoricals)) %>%
  setdiff("hospdead")

# 2. Generate all plots and store them in a list
plot_list <- map(categorical_variables, function(variable) {
  if (variable == "edu") {
    support2 %>%
      mutate(
        hospdead = as.factor(hospdead),
        current_var = as.factor(case_when(
          edu <= 8  ~ "Básica (0-8)",
          edu <= 12 ~ "Secundaria (9-12)",
          edu > 12  ~ "Superior (>12)"
        ))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(current_var)) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = current_var, fill = hospdead)) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Mortalidad según", variable),
        x = variable,
        y = "Número de Pacientes",
        fill = "Muerte Hospitalaria"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else if (variable == "pafi") {
    support2 %>%
      mutate(
        hospdead = as.factor(hospdead),
        current_var = case_when(
          pafi < 100 ~ "Severe (<100)",
          pafi >= 100 & pafi <= 200 ~ "Moderate (100-200)",
          pafi > 200 & pafi <= 300 ~ "Mild (200-300)",
          pafi > 300 ~ "Normal (>300)",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        # Se fuerza el orden clínico correcto para la gráfica
        current_var = factor(current_var, levels = c("Normal (>300)", "Mild (200-300)", "Moderate (100-200)", "Severe (<100)"))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(current_var)) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = current_var, fill = hospdead)) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Mortalidad según", variable),
        x = variable,
        y = "Número de Pacientes",
        fill = "Muerte Hospitalaria"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    support2 %>%
      mutate(
        hospdead = as.factor(hospdead),
        current_var = as.factor(.data[[variable]])
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(current_var)) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = current_var, fill = hospdead)) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Mortalidad según", variable),
        x = variable,
        y = "Número de Pacientes",
        fill = "Muerte Hospitalaria"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }
})

# 3. Define layout parameters (4 plots per page in a 2x2 grid)
plots_per_page <- 4
plot_chunks <- split(plot_list, ceiling(seq_along(plot_list) / plots_per_page))

# 4. Loop through chunks and render them as paginated grids
walk2(plot_chunks, seq_along(plot_chunks), function(chunk, page_num) {
  grid.arrange(
    grobs = chunk, 
    ncol = 2, 
    nrow = 2,
    top = paste("Análisis Variable Categórica - Página", page_num)
  )
})
```

```{r}
# 1. Identify continuous variables (excluding manual categories and target)
continuous_variables <- support2 %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names() %>%
  setdiff(manual_categoricals)

# 2. Generate all boxplots and store them in a list
plot_list <- map(continuous_variables, function(variable) {
  support2 %>%
    mutate(hospdead = as.factor(hospdead)) %>%
    # Remove NA rows for both the variable and target to avoid empty aesthetics
    filter(!is.na(.data[[variable]]), !is.na(hospdead)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = hospdead, y = .data[[variable]], fill = hospdead)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Dispersión de", variable),
      x = "Muerte Hospitalaria (hospdead)",
      y = variable,
      fill = "Hospdead"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") # Remove legend since x-axis already shows the groups
})

# 3. Define layout parameters (4 boxplots per page in a 2x2 grid)
plots_per_page <- 4
plot_chunks <- split(plot_list, ceiling(seq_along(plot_list) / plots_per_page))

# 4. Loop through chunks and render them as paginated grids
walk2(plot_chunks, seq_along(plot_chunks), function(chunk, page_num) {
  grid.arrange(
    grobs = chunk, 
    ncol = 2, 
    nrow = 2,
    top = paste("Análisis de Dispersión Numérica - Página", page_num)
  )
})
```

```{r}
# Make correlation matrix

  select(where(is.numeric))

cor_matrix <- cor(
  numeric_data,
  use = "complete.obs"
)

corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  tl.cex = 0.6
)
```
```{r}
# Convert matrix to table
cor_table <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix))

cor_table <- cor_table %>%
  filter(Var1 != Var2)

cor_table <- cor_table %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(Var1, Var2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_table <- cor_table %>%
  mutate(abs_cor = abs(Freq)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_cor))

head(cor_table, 40)
```
